step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram displays a serverless web application and model publishing platform architecture for 3M. Amazon CloudFront serves as the entry point, routing requests to Amazon API Gateway. API Gateway sends traffic to an ECS (Fargate) container layer, which interacts with Amazon DynamoDB for configuration/access management and triggers compute jobs on Amazon EC2 (HPC cluster). AWS Step Functions orchestrates model deployment by interacting with DynamoDB and EC2. Results from the HPC cluster on EC2 and metadata from DynamoDB flow to Amazon S3. Visual nodes identified: CloudFront, API Gateway, ECS, DynamoDB, Step Functions, EC2, and S3.
